oracle: a fork starts its own record (A15.2, SPEC §21): its stats are its own first version published and nothing its source was read for
what: forkDocument copies the source's stats into the fork (functions/src/lib/fork.ts), so the fork starts with its source's views, reading time and counts as if they were its own

target.case: A15.2 a fork of a trusted public document is private, trusted:false, forked:true and marked by the forker's default, with nothing naming its parent; v1 is publishedVia fork with the source's bytes (REHASH); forks/{id} is server-only; stats.forks counts each fork once and nothing else moves
